protocol.selection: Every seed retained; early stopping on validation only; no test-set optimization or automatic winner selection.
protocol.allocation: Models use different parameter counts and computation despite common neural context and AdamW settings. LightGBM uses single-date factors and boosting.

declared_protocols.comparability: all scratch models share factors, target and chronological splits; neural models share 32-session context and AdamW budget; LightGBM uses one factor row and boosting; parameter counts and effective depth differ
declared_protocols.holdout: exploratory historical comparison; a previously inspected interval is not a fresh final holdout
declared_protocols.pretrained: official TimesFM3 is a separate fixed-weight replay with 256-session price context and unknown pretraining overlap

software_validation.mechanism_tests: causality, padding, routing/expert gradients, loop sharing, sparse cache/index reuse, delta recurrence, residual gates, prefix normalization/refinement
software_validation.qlib_replay: All four mini architectures trained with real Qlib; saved model and dataset replay matched every score/index exactly with scaler refitting forbidden.
software_validation.official_pretrained_runtime: Actual checkpoint on Python 3.12 CPU; CI adapter tests use a mock and never download weights.

metadata.label: Ref($close, -2) / Ref($close, -1) - 1
metadata.pretraining_overlap: unknown; historical replay is not a clean unseen holdout

independent_audit.audit_scope: Independent artifact, label alignment, checkpoint provenance, and sampled real inference review

dependencies.python_3_10_resolution: Requires a compatible older torch within the declared >=2.5,<3 range; torch2.5.1 metadata permits >=3.8.0 and publishes a cp310 wheel.

independent_audit.price_semantics: Provider $close in price units, including upstream adjustments. Yahoo input conversion applies Adj Close / Close to OHLC. Model input and label use the same adjusted close series.
limitations: Pretraining overlap with the historical market data is unknown.
The full replay RMSE is slightly worse than the zero-return baseline.
Saved adapter reload requires access to the separately stored local checkpoint.
independent_audit.audit_modifications: Only documentation/docstring wording was corrected; runtime behavior and saved benchmark artifacts were unchanged.

predictions.alignment: All 19 model runs have identical indices and raw labels; every scratch RMSE was recomputed from CSV after restoring Qlib float32 labels. This combined CSV stores their exact float32 values as float64 decimal strings.

limitations: The 2013-2018 historical interval was previously inspected; this is exploratory, not a fresh untouched final holdout.
One index and one chronological split do not establish current-market generalization or profitability.
Population standard deviation across three seeds is initialization dispersion, not a confidence interval.
Mini models are original from-scratch numerical adaptations, not pretrained or distilled flagship models.
Official TimesFM3 uses 256 provider closes, fixed external weights, and unknown pretraining overlap; it is separate from the supervised comparison.
No portfolio simulation is attached to the nontradable index comparison; costed portfolio execution is tested on synthetic instruments.
